info.name: Modernizing Enterprise Applications (Python) — Behavior-Equivalence Suite
info.description: r01 golden baseline (walking skeleton). Captured against the running Django monolith (examples/00-monolith) — the ONLY backend that exists at r01, so {{baseUrl}} points straight at it (http://localhost:8000). This is the Python sibling of ~/Dev/modernizing-enterprise-applications/tooling/newman/mea.postman_collection.json, scoped down to that project's r02 synchronous-monolith baseline: Smoke + four checkout scenarios, no bounded-wait polling of any kind, because r01 has no extracted services and no asynchrony to wait on yet. Every request is parameterized by {{baseUrl}} on purpose — this exact, unedited collection is meant to be re-pointed at each later iteration's extracted service/proxy as it lands, the same load-bearing contract the Java project's suite plays. See GOLDEN-BASELINE.md for the full run record and the four smell-cross-reference failure paths this exercises (common/exceptions.py's ApiError subclasses, order/services.py's single transaction.atomic()).
